parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the route target group instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteTargetGroupDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the route target group. 

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: RouteTargetGroupId
parameters.description: The routing target group instance ID.

parameters.name: RouteTargetGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the route target group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: RouteTargetMemberList
parameters.description:
The member list of the route target group.

In active/standby mode, the following limits apply to route target group members:

1. The number of route target group members must be 2.
2. The route target group members must belong to different zones.

sub_parameters.name: MemberId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the route target group member.

sub_parameters.name: MemberType
sub_parameters.description:
The member type of the route target group.

Currently supported type:

- **GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint**

In active/standby mode, all members of the route target group must be of the same type.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight of the route target group member. Valid values:

- 100: The member is the active instance.
- 0: The member is the standby instance.

The weight can only be set during creation and cannot be modified.
